notes.title: Project Update #34 is now LIVE on Kickstarter
notes.notes:
Greetings, Adventurers!

Welcome to our Kickstarter Project Update #34 for Pathfinder: Abomination Vaults! We’re thrilled to bring you exciting news about the game’s progress and some sneak peeks into the world you’ll explore. Have a seat with our four iconics, and enjoy!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787730/4cc719cd626d8329b21158b5bdc16a14385ed854.png

A New Wave of Playtests Is Coming!

Here comes a fresh wave of playtests! This round will introduce brand-new gameplay elements including most that were mentioned in previous project updates like Otari, deeper progression in the Darklands, the firecamps, skills, loadouts, all four playable characters, features, and mechanics that will push Pathfinder: Abomination Vaults further. For more information about these, please keep on reading!

Your feedback has been important so far, and we can't wait to see what you think of these new additions!

You would like to be part of our upcoming playtest? Head to our Kickstarter Project Update now!
